title: Configuration file not found
action: Save the settings from Admin > Seda Sanj, or reinstall the module.

title: Configuration file cannot be parsed
action: Re-save the settings from the module page or restore config.ini.example.

title: Configuration value is invalid
action: Open the module page, correct the highlighted setting and save again.

title: Upload endpoint is missing or not https
action: Enter the https:// upload endpoint shown in your Seda Sanj panel.

title: Service cannot start: configuration error
action: Fix the configuration (see the preceding SS-CFG error) and restart the service.

title: Persistent storage fell back to JSON files
action: Check that pdo_sqlite is loaded and that /var/lib/asterisk-recording-uploader is owned by asterisk.

title: Unexpected error in a service loop
action: Read the message; if it repeats, run the doctor command and send the support bundle.

title: pcntl extension is missing
action: Install php-pcntl for a clean service stop, or accept a forced stop by systemd.

title: Another service instance is already running
action: Stop the duplicate: systemctl status asterisk-recording-uploader; only one instance may run.

title: Recording hook was called without required arguments
action: Re-run the module activation so the MixMonitor globals are rewritten.

title: Recording hook rejected an unsafe argument
action: Normally harmless (a caller ID with unusual characters). If it affects normal calls, check the MIXMON_POST globals.

title: Stereo merge of the call legs failed
action: Check that MON_FMT is wav and that disk space is available; the recording is kept and retried.

title: Metadata sidecar could not be written
action: Free disk space or fix ownership of the monitor directory.

title: FreePBX callrecording patch is missing (updated by FreePBX?)
action: Re-apply the module activation; recordings are not passing through the hook until you do.

title: Audio file cannot be read
action: Check that the file exists and is readable by the asterisk user.

title: Audio file is not a valid or complete WAV
action: The recording was cut off; nothing to fix unless it happens on every call.

title: Audio format is not supported (needs 16-bit PCM WAV)
action: Set the FreePBX recording format to WAV.

title: Call legs do not match (rate or bit depth)
action: Use one codec for both legs of the recording.

title: Recording has no audio samples
action: The call was never bridged; the file is ignored.

title: Recording could not be staged (copy or gzip failed)
action: Free disk space and check ownership of /var/spool/asterisk-recording-uploader.

title: ffmpeg failed while creating the local archive copy
action: Install ffmpeg or set the archive format to wav or gsm. Upload is not blocked.

title: No GSM encoder is available for the local archive copy
action: Install gsm-utils, use the bundled encoder for your CPU, or set the archive format to wav. Upload is not blocked.

title: ZIP encryption (7zip) failed
action: Check that the bundled 7zzs binary is executable and not on a noexec mount, or use gzip uploads.

title: Staged file is larger than the API limit
action: Shorten the recording or raise the limit on the server side.

title: GSM archive needs an 8 kHz source
action: Set archive format to wav for wideband recordings. Upload is not blocked.

title: Metadata sidecar for the staged file could not be written
action: Free disk space or fix ownership of the spool directory.

title: Voicemail audio could not be converted
action: Install ffmpeg or use the bundled binary; check the voicemail file.

title: Required call metadata is missing
action: Usually an unusual call (no caller or dialed number). The recording is kept in failed/.

title: Recording file disappeared before upload
action: Check for a second uploader instance or manual deletion.

title: Server reported this call as already received
action: No action; if the call is missing in the panel contact support with the call ID.

title: Network error while uploading
action: Check connectivity from the PBX to the endpoint (curl -v).

title: DNS lookup of the endpoint failed
action: Fix the PBX DNS resolver or the endpoint host name.

title: Connection to the endpoint was refused or unreachable
action: Check firewall rules and the endpoint URL and port.

title: Upload timed out
action: Check the uplink speed; raise the timeout for long recordings.

title: TLS/certificate problem talking to the endpoint
action: Fix the PBX clock and install current ca-certificates; do not disable verification in production.

title: Endpoint rejected the request (HTTP 400)
action: Check the endpoint URL and the upload format setting.

title: API key rejected (HTTP 401)
action: Create/rotate the key in the panel and re-import the configuration. Queued recordings are kept and resume automatically.

title: Credit exhausted (HTTP 402)
action: Top up the account; uploads resume automatically.

title: Access denied or account suspended (HTTP 403)
action: Contact support; queued recordings are kept and resume automatically.

title: Endpoint path not found (HTTP 404)
action: The endpoint must end with /v1/ingest/calls.

title: Upload too large (HTTP 413)
action: Raise the proxy body limit or shorten recordings.

title: Upload format does not match the API key (HTTP 415)
action: Set the upload format (gzip/zip) to the one configured for the key.

title: Server rejected the data (HTTP 422)
action: Check the archive password and the call numbers; see the message for the field.

title: Rate limited (HTTP 429)
action: No action; the module backs off automatically.

title: Server error (HTTP 5xx)
action: No action; the module retries. If it persists, check the Seda Sanj status page.

title: Unexpected HTTP response
action: Read the status and message; check proxies in front of the endpoint.

title: Queued recording no longer exists
action: Usually raced with a manual cleanup; no action.

title: Retry queue could not be written
action: Free disk space and fix ownership of /var/lib/asterisk-recording-uploader.

title: Upload attempt failed; will retry
action: No action unless it keeps failing; see the attached cause code.

title: Upload failed permanently; recording moved to failed/
action: Fix the cause, then run requeue-failed to retry.

title: Uploads are paused: credit exhausted
action: Top up the account; the queue resumes automatically.

title: Uploads are paused: configuration or account problem
action: Fix the API key / account (see the attached cause code); the queue resumes automatically.

title: Orphan recording kept: metadata is incomplete
action: Inspect the file; delete or re-queue it manually.

title: Orphan recording recovered and queued
action: No action.

title: Voicemail spool is missing or unreadable
action: Fix the spool path or give the asterisk user read access.

title: Voicemail metadata is incomplete
action: Usually transient while Asterisk is still writing the message.

title: Voicemail processing failed
action: See the attached cause code.

title: Missed-call poll failed: CDR unavailable
action: Check MariaDB access and cdr.conf (unanswered=yes).

title: Missed-call upload failed
action: See the attached cause code.

title: Missed-call state could not be saved
action: Free disk space and fix ownership of the state directory.

title: FreePBX bootstrap (/etc/freepbx.conf) not found
action: Missed calls and answered-extension lookup need a FreePBX host.

title: CDR table is missing required columns
action: Check the CDR database schema.

title: CDR database connection failed
action: Check that MariaDB is running and FreePBX can reach it.

title: FreePBX extension list is unavailable
action: Run the sync from a FreePBX host with the core module enabled (needs /etc/freepbx.conf).

title: FreePBX has no extensions to sync
action: Create extensions in Applications > Extensions, then sync again.

title: Extension sync could not reach Seda Sanj
action: Check the endpoint, API key and connectivity on the module page, then sync again.

title: PHP version is too old
action: Install PHP 7.4 or newer for the CLI engine.

title: A required PHP extension is missing
action: Install the extension named in the message and restart PHP/the service.

title: FreePBX version is not supported
action: Supported: FreePBX 15 (PHP 7.4 CLI), 16 and 17.

title: Root activation is required
action: Run the activation command shown on the module page as root.

title: Disk is full or nearly full
action: Free space on the volume holding /var/spool and /var/lib.

title: System clock differs from the server
action: Fix NTP on the PBX; skew breaks TLS and scheduling.

title: A required directory is not writable
action: Fix ownership: chown -R asterisk:asterisk on the module directories.

title: Automatic update is unavailable on this host
action: See the reason shown on the module page (sodium, helper, signing key).

title: Release signature or checksum is invalid
action: Do not install; contact support.

title: Release download failed
action: Check connectivity and disk space, then retry.

title: Downgrade or replay of an older release refused
action: No action; only newer releases are installed automatically.

title: Update helper failed
action: Open the update log on the module page; the previous version is restored automatically.

title: Update failed and rollback was incomplete
action: Restore from the backup path shown in the update log.

title: A required FreePBX module is not installed
action: Install it from the Dependencies tab or with fwconsole ma downloadinstall.

title: A required PHP extension is missing
action: Install the extension from your OS packages.

title: An optional tool is missing
action: Install it only if you use the related feature.
